beats.subline: Thursday, October 1, 2026 close — modest, broad-based gains as Treasury yields eased from two-decade highs on softer jobs data.
beats.body: Stocks opened October with narrow gains as the 10-year Treasury yield slipped to 5.24% after soft jobs data eased fears the Fed would delay further rate cuts; small-caps outperformed, with the Russell 2000 up 0.35%.

beats.headline: Sixth suspect, a dual UK-Iranian national, arrested in plot targeting US-linked UK air base
beats.body: British counterterrorism police arrested a 25-year-old dual UK-Iranian national Thursday, the sixth person held in the probe into suspicious vehicles near RAF Fairford — the base that has hosted US B-1 and B-52 bombers flying missions against Iran — after UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said there were 'strong indications' Iran played a part; Iran's embassy has denied any involvement.

beats.headline: Taiwan indicts three ex-military personnel for allegedly spying for China
beats.body: Kaohsiung prosecutors charged three former service members, surnamed Chen, Lu and Mao, with funneling classified secrets — including tank specifications and Han Kuang military exercise details — to Chinese Communist Party intelligence contacts since 2020, the latest in a string of espionage cases Taipei says reflects Beijing's effort to penetrate its armed forces.

beats.headline: US sends third aircraft carrier and thousands more troops toward the Middle East
beats.body: About 9,000 additional sailors and Marines — including the Theodore Roosevelt carrier strike group and the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group — are steaming toward the Middle East, a buildup that could put three US carriers in the region by late October as President Trump warns new strikes on Iran remain possible.

beats.headline: Pentagon orders 14,000 AI-guided attack drones from startup Neros
beats.body: The Department of War placed a $100 million-plus order for 14,000 Archer-series first-person-view drones, including the autonomously-guided Archer AI variant, after Neros topped the Pentagon's Gauntlet II 'Drone Dominance' competition at Fort Carson — the largest single award among roughly 60,000 drones purchased across the program.

beats.headline: Anthropic reportedly eyes mid-November IPO at up to $2 trillion valuation
beats.body: Anthropic is said to be preparing to begin marketing its IPO the week of November 9, with investor meetings starting around October 14, in a listing that could value the company as high as $2 trillion — which would be the largest IPO ever — after revenue surged from $386 million in 2024 to $4.6 billion in 2025.

beats.headline: Goodell meets again with Pritzker as Bears stadium talks continue
beats.body: NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell met Thursday with Gov. JB Pritzker, legislative leaders and Bears minority owner Pat Ryan in Chicago for what the governor's office called a 'productive' discussion on keeping the team in Illinois, though sources described no breakthrough even as the Bears continue advancing their Hammond, Indiana stadium plan.

beats.headline: Hendrick Motorsports extends HP sponsorship of William Byron's No. 24 car through 2029
beats.body: Hendrick Motorsports and HP Inc. extended their partnership through the 2029 NASCAR Cup Series season, continuing HP's primary sponsorship of Byron's No. 24 Chevrolet for two races annually.
